1. By way of this common order, aforesaid two petitions, which relate to the same school, are being disposed of.

2. In CWP No.8673 of 2019, the challenge by the petitioner-school is with regard to the demand of Rs.63,96,964/- as lease money for extending the lease so as to that the petitioner-school can continue in the said premises.

3. Learned counsel for the respondent-State submits that as per his instructions he has received, the respondent-State is already reconsidering the said issue and the same is under active consideration; VINOD KUMAR - 2 - . ./ 0 "/ 1 the petitioner needs revision or not, will be passed within a period of three months from today and in case it is found that it is feasible to grant any relief to the petitioner-school, the same will be granted to it and on the contrary, if it is found that the petitioner’s claim has to be declined, a well reasoned speaking order will be passed and conveyed to the petitioner-school and till then, the School will be allowed to function as it has been functioning without there being any impediment.

4. Learned counsel for the respondent-State further submits that in CWP-8180-2019, the issue relates to the grant of affiliation to the petitioner-school, which is not being granted owing to the nonfinalization of the lease dispute between the parties and as the issue with regard to the extension of lease is already under active consideration, in case whenever the issue will be resolved between the parties, the issue of grant of affiliation to the petitioner-institute will be considered in the light of the finalization of the issue of extension of lease qua the lease amount and an appropriate order will be passed, in case need be, and till the said issue is decided, the affiliation already granted to the petitionerinstitute will continue.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioner-school submits that keeping in view the statement made by the learned counsel for the respondent-State, the present petitions may kindly be disposed of having been not pressed.

6. Ordered accordingly.
